title: Letter grade
hints: A tagless switch is `switch { case <bool expression>: ... }`. The first true case wins and the switch ends — no `break` needed.
Handle the invalid range first with `case score < 0 || score > 100:`. After that, every remaining score is between 0 and 100.
Then go from the highest grade down: `case score >= 90: return "A"`, `case score >= 80: return "B"`, ... and `default: return "F"`.
